decisions.reason: A net price display plugin costs little to maintain and is still within its first year, so with no clear shortfall against aspirations, slack lets the firm carry it while results remain uncertain.
ERP interface plugins tend to tie customers into the firm's established business, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.
This is one of three overlapping price comparison tracking plugins, which raises some risk of consolidation, but it is too early to see a performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
Its overlap with C and E makes it a candidate for streamlining if results fall short, but low maintenance costs and limited evidence so far favor keeping it.
This duplicate tracking plugin may be consolidated later, but without evidence of underperformance the satisficing management keeps it for now.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A and serves the firm's core market research offering, so it is kept while it builds a track record.
